subject: english
stem: Website visits rose during the same week that a poster campaign began. No control period was used. What may be said?
options: Time had no relation to the data.
The rise occurred alongside the campaign, but causation is uncertain.
The posters proved they caused every visit.

optionRationales.reason: The campaign certainly reduced visits.：方向與數據相反。
Time had no relation to the data.：week 是觀察範圍。
The rise occurred alongside the campaign, but causation is uncertain.：同時發生支持關聯，缺 control 不能確定因果。
The posters proved they caused every visit.：過度因果。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「結論的每個範圍詞與因果強度都不超過文中方法和結果」可推出 The rise occurred alongside the campaign, but causation is uncertain.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The rise occurred alongside the campaign, but causation is uncertain. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
